texts.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Your assistance in ending the heretical research carried out by the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] is no longer needed, as a ban has already been placed on all further machine intelligence research in that empire. While you did not play any part in doing so, at least this threat to the spiritual well-being of the galaxy is dealt with.
